pelage_geometry_and_topology.patch_morphology: Irregular, multi-lobate dark brown geometries with jagged edge gradients; patches exhibit star-like or dendritic projections with high internal color density.
pelage_geometry_and_topology.corridor_network: Interconnected cream-colored interstitial pathways forming complex multi-nodal junctions; pathway width is non-uniform, ranging from narrow pixel-strips to broader nodes.

dorsal_ridge_profile.edge_serration: Continuous 1D contour along the upper neck composed of short, vertical brown tufts creating a low-amplitude, high-frequency serrated silhouette.

other_distinctive_markers: Presence of an avian organism (oxpecker) perched on the upper dorsal region at the junction of the neck and shoulder.
